{{Quote|Sul Prine's place is on Talus. Which is interesting. If the Meatlumps were truly responsible for the destruction of those bikes, that means they are branching out to other planets. I wonder how many Meatlumps have died when they destroyed the transport on which they were traveling.|[[Vani Korr]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP3" />}}
'''Sul Prine's Place''' was a small home owned by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] racer named [[Sul Prine]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The house was located on the edge of one of [[Talus/Legends|Talus']] major [[City/Legends|cities]], [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP3" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the technology-hating [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] criminals damaged several speeder bikes that were parked outside the house. When [[Vani Korr]], a ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] who was investigating the Meatlumps learned of this attack, she tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate. The adventurer met Sul Prine at his place and the latter confirmed that the Meatlumps were responsible of the attack. Prine also gave the spacer a Meatlump map he had found. The map allowed the adventurer to eventually find the location of the [[Meatlump Camps]] on Talus.<ref name="SWG:TMHP3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sul Prine's Place was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:TMHP3" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sul Prine's Place was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
